hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); [ -z "$CMD" ] && exit 0; TARGET=$(echo "$CMD" | sed -E 's/[;&|#].*$//'); if echo "$TARGET" | grep -qE '^\s*(sudo\s+)?rm\s+.*-[rRf]*[rR]' && ! echo "$TARGET" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]/])(node_modules|dist|build|__pycache__|tmp)(/|[[:space:]]|$)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: recursive rm on non-safe target. Use specific paths.' >&2; exit 2; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); [ -z "$CMD" ] && exit 0; CHECK=$(echo "$CMD" | sed -E 's/--force-with-lease(=[^[:space:]]*)?//g'); if echo "$CHECK" | grep -qE 'git\s+push\s+.*--force|git\s+reset\s+--hard|git\s+clean\s+-fd'; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive git operation. Use --force-with-lease, git revert, or git stash.' >&2; exit 2; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); [ -z "$CMD" ] && exit 0; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE '(api[._-]?key|secret|password|token).*=.*[A-Za-z0-9]{20}'; then echo 'BLOCKED: potential credential in command. Use environment variables.' >&2; exit 2; fi

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; BASE=$(basename "$FILE"); if echo "$BASE" | grep -qE '^\.env\.(example|sample|template)$'; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$BASE" | grep -qE '^\.env(\..+)?$|\.(pem|key|p12|pfx|credentials|secret)$|^(credentials|secrets?|id_rsa|id_ed25519|\.netrc|\.npmrc)$'; then echo 'BLOCKED: writing to sensitive file. Check if this is intentional.' >&2; exit 2; fi
